resolved_defects.title: Daily sticker allowance resets on the UTC day boundary
resolved_defects.detail: The 'day' key is the UTC date, so the 20-sticker allowance resets at 00:00 UTC (7pm/4pm US Eastern/Pacific) instead of the user's midnight. Repro: a US user exhausts 20 stickers at 6pm ET, gets 20 more at 7pm ET; another user loses unused allowance mid-evening. Store a per-user IANA timezone (or document UTC reset in the UI) and compute the day key from it.

resolved_defects.title: Redirect fails with 5xx when click tracking fails
resolved_defects.detail: The click log write is inside the redirect path and its failure returns a 5xx. On read-only/serverless file systems, a full disk or a missing directory, every `/go/<productId>` link becomes a dead end, losing affiliate revenue. Log best-effort and still issue the 302.

resolved_defects.title: Outbound email to user-supplied address without unsubscribe/consent handling
resolved_defects.detail: The message goes to a third party who never opted in and carries no `List-Unsubscribe` header or opt-out link. Under GDPR/CAN-SPAM this needs a suppression list and a one-click unsubscribe (validated with a signed token), otherwise the sender domain can be reported for spam.

resolved_defects.detail: Without a relation the database cannot enforce referential integrity: deleting the parent leaves orphan rows and a bad id is accepted silently. Declare the relation (with an `onDelete` rule) or rename the column.

resolved_defects.title: SQLite datasource: single-writer contention not configured
resolved_defects.detail: SQLite allows one writer. Concurrent Stripe webhooks + checkout transactions can fail with SQLITE_BUSY/timeouts, leaving rows like Listing.state='reserved' or Purchase.state='pending' stuck. Use `?connection_limit=1&socket_timeout=...` in DATABASE_URL, keep transactions short, and rely on Stripe retries plus a reconciliation job.

resolved_defects.title: Foreign key `Session.userId` has no index
resolved_defects.detail: Prisma does not index foreign keys on SQLite; lookups and cascading deletes scan the table and hold the single writer lock longer, increasing SQLITE_BUSY contention. Add `@@index([userId])`.
